assessment.rationale: Reported consolidated four-year CFO is about 96.18% of group NPAT; this is a cash-realization diagnostic, not the normalized M3 ratio. assessment.rationale: FY2025 written-off-debt recoveries of 14.773450 trillion VND versus 8.018025 trillion in FY2024 and an investment-risk reversal of 1.151939 trillion are specific source-read earnings drivers. The inherited adverse known-axis common-earnings case is 10.600906 trillion versus reported common reference 26.457802 trillion. The mix of recoveries, reversal and total-credit-cost proxy changes forward earnings precision materially; this is high economic estimation uncertainty, not a penalty for missing files or a cost-of-equity grid width.
